sysutils.c.reason: get_avail_memory issues DPMI 0500h with a 32-bit linear buffer address; the block arenas hold native records that carry 8-byte pointers.
divergences: get_avail_memory reports PORT_FREE_MEMORY (16 MiB) instead of querying DPMI; InitMemoryVariable therefore always takes its >= 3 MiB branch (normal mode, all sprites, backgrounds).
init_memory allocates PORT_ARENA_SCALE (2 on 64-bit hosts) times the requested capacity; block_malloc semantics are unchanged, only the out-of-memory threshold moves.

load.c.reason: Level/world loading reads 32-bit file words into pointer-typed fields and reads 132-byte DOS object images directly into obj_t; both depend on the 32-bit DOS layout.
divergences: Pointer-typed fields that receive a 32-bit file word (animations[].frames x3, ScrollDiffSprites, wldobj[].eta) are filled by port_fread_pointer_word (sign-extended word); the original sentinel tests and (s32) narrowing are unchanged.

Object instance records are decoded field by field from their DOS offsets (game/dos_records.c, offsets from docs/semantics/generated/semantics_dos.h); the four index words are rebound with the original (s16) narrowing. A malloc scratch array holds the index words; the game allocators are not touched.

load_world reads the BIOS tick byte at linear 0x46C four times while waiting for two tick edges (with the debug-register watch around it); the reads use port_bios_tick_byte(), the tick derived from the port clock. The watch itself is omitted (docs/port/PLATFORM_OPEN.md).

data/blk_215c.c.reason: DisplayBufferNormal is initialised with the VGA linear address 0xA0000.
divergences: DisplayBufferNormal points to the port display aperture (video/vga.c port_vga_aperture), the device that replaces VGA memory.

box.c.reason: Fire, CadreTrans and ClearBorder form draw-buffer addresses through a u32 round trip ((u8 *)((u32)draw_buffer + n)), which truncates a 64-bit pointer.
divergences: The four address computations use pointer arithmetic draw_buffer + n; for every in-range offset this is the same address the 32-bit u32 arithmetic produced. No other change.

map_ngawe.c.reason: INIT_GAME_MODE_NORMAL installs Copy_Plan0Diff_To_Buf behind island_copy_t, whose C parameter order (source, dest, pitch, height, width) differs from the routine's direct prototype (source, dest, width, height, pitch); the DOS register ABI made both views the same.
divergences: Copy_Plan0_To_Buf receives the adapter port_island_copy_plan0diff (video/lowlevel_adapters.c), which reorders the arguments for the same routine. Same pixels.

frame.c.reason: SWAP_BUFFERS calls Swap_And_Test_Joystick through frame.c's swap_func_t view, which lists EDI (destination) first; pcmain.c's view of the same pointer and the native routine take (source, destination).
divergences: The normal-mode joystick swap call passes (DrawBufferNormal, display_buffer): the same registers the DOS call loaded (ESI source, EDI destination).

jumelle.c.reason: PrepareJumelleZoom indexes its zoom table with u32 expressions (x - y*224, -y*224 - x, ...) that wrap to negative offsets in 32-bit arithmetic; on a 64-bit host the wrapped value is a +4 GiB offset.
divergences: The eight left[]/right[] index expressions are cast to s32: the same offsets the 32-bit program used. Found by the first native run (segmentation fault); this class is caught systematically by the i686 reference build (port/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
